name: Card
summary: A bordered box that groups related content on a surface. Never interactive as a whole — buttons and links live inside it. No shadow: the 1 px border does the work on every theme; elevation belongs to overlays (Popover, Toast), which use the raised variant for their body.

pattern.name: No ARIA pattern — a generic container. Becomes a region only when rendered as a section with aria-labelledby.

children.intent: The grouped content. Headings, text, chips, buttons — the card imposes no structure on them.

variant.intent: Which surface token the box sits on. surface = cards and panels on the page (color.surface.raised — white on linen's warm page). raised = the body of a popover, palette or toast (color.surface.overlay). The overlay component adds the shadow; the card never does.

padding.intent: Inset 16 / 24 px (space.inset.md / lg). The handoff's 'padding 600 desktop / 400 phone': the pattern chooses md on phone. Card never reads the viewport — components do not own responsive behaviour (CONTRIBUTING).

radius.intent: 12 / 14 px (radius.lg / radius.xl). xl is the triage card's radius 500; everything else is lg.

as.intent: The element. section + aria-labelledby makes the card a named region (one per screen at most); article for a self-contained item (an application, an experiment); li inside a list of cards. div has no semantics.

aria-labelledby.requiredWhen: as is 'section' — a section without a name is not a landmark and only adds noise.
aria-labelledby.intent: The id of the heading inside the card that names the region.

a11y.name: None by default (a div). With as='section' + aria-labelledby, the heading's text names the region.
a11y.announcements: None. Everything a screen reader hears comes from the content; the card itself is silent.
a11y.targetSize: Not a target. A card is never a button or a link; the targets inside it (Button, Chip filter, done ring) meet their own sizes.

rules: Never make the whole card clickable. A card-as-link hides where the target is, breaks 2.5.8 (one huge target with the real controls inside it) and makes nested buttons invalid HTML. Put a Button or Link inside and let the heading be the link text.

No shadow, on any theme. The 1 px color.border.default edge separates a card from the page; elevation (shadow.overlay) belongs to Popover and Toast, which use variant='raised' for their body and add the shadow themselves.
No outer margin. Layout — gaps between cards, columns, gutters — is the parent's job (Stack, Grid). A card with margin breaks every container it is placed in.
padding='md' is the phone value, chosen by the pattern that knows its viewport. Card contains no media query (CONTRIBUTING: components never read window size).
as='section' requires aria-labelledby pointing at the heading inside; otherwise render a div. One named region per screen is plenty — ten regions are worse than none.

Linen check (docs/decisions.md, recommendation 5): on linen the card is white on a warm page and the edge is 1.21:1 — separation comes from the surface contrast, not the border. Verify on the Today screen with 6–8 cards before trusting it; if it does not read, the fix is the page surface (surface.sunken), not a shadow.
